headline: Plannotator Brings Agents Into Review
lede: Plannotator gives autonomous coding systems a structured checkpoint between plan and execution. Its local inbox, annotations, hooks, and version-control integrations let humans shape agent work without interrupting active sessions.

headline: A Field Guide to the Modern Web
lede: Modern Web Guidance packages browser expertise into searchable, token-efficient references for coding agents. Its guides favor native platform capabilities, accessibility, and performance while helping teams replace inherited patterns with current practice.

headline: Claude Turns Trading Into a Repeatable Practice
lede: Claude Trading Skills treats market analysis as a sequence of checklists, gates, and retrospectives rather than a hunt for magic signals. Modular skills cover screening, risk, sizing, journaling, and review while leaving final decisions with the human operator.

headline: DevTools Gives Coding Agents a Live Browser
lede: Chrome DevTools MCP connects agents to the browser surface where applications actually run. Through MCP and the CLI, they can navigate, inspect network traffic, read console output, capture traces, and investigate accessibility or performance issues.

headline: Open Code Review Hunts Defects Line by Line
lede: Alibaba’s Open Code Review combines deterministic file selection with an LLM that investigates context across a codebase. The command-line workflow flags issues from thread safety to injection risks, then returns precise, resumable comments for local or pipeline use.

headline: Qwen Code Builds an Agentic Command Line
lede: Qwen Code turns the terminal into a control room for repository inspection, edits, commands, worktrees, and coordinated subagents. It also extends the same workflow into editors, browsers, CI systems, SDKs, and daemon-backed shared sessions.

headline: Univer Embeds a Modular Office Suite
lede: Univer supplies the canvas, plugins, and APIs behind customizable spreadsheets, documents, and presentations. Its browser-and-Node.js design supports both polished interactive editors and headless processing for data-rich, AI-native products.

headline: AG-UI Connects Agents to Living Interfaces
lede: AG-UI defines an event stream for moving agent activity into user-facing applications. Its transport-agnostic protocol synchronizes state, streams chat, supports generative UI, and keeps humans in the loop across frameworks and clients.

headline: TensorFold Runs LLMs Close to the Metal
lede: TensorFold serves local models from a compact Zig binary, dispatching optimized Metal, CUDA, or Vulkan kernels without a Python or MLX installation. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, hardware reporting, and configurable concurrency make the engine practical to measure and deploy.

headline: Caveman Cuts the Cost of Agent Sessions
lede: Caveman strips needless prose and compresses the logs, data files, and web pages that coding agents consume. Its proxy and reusable blocks target lower context pressure, latency, and spend across several popular agent clients.
